name: Alibaba.com Global B2B
description: Verified suppliers with Trade Assurance protection, custom prototyping, and bulk ocean container quotes.
fullDescription: Alibaba.com is the world’s largest international B2B sourcing portal, connecting buyers with vetted manufacturers and trading companies. It features robust buyer protection through Trade Assurance, verified inspection reports by SGS/TÜV Rheinland, and flexible payment terms for full container loads.
features: Trade Assurance escrow protection for production deadlines and product quality
Verified Supplier badges backed by third-party on-site audit videos
Request for Quotation (RFQ) marketplace to get competitive supplier bids fast
Customizable product molds, packaging, and private label engraving options
Integrated ocean freight and air express quotes directly at checkout
